proof_findings: Conditional identities and comparator coefficient are valid for fixed exogenous table and frozen p with predictable block probabilities.
Probability floor yields (1/pi-1)^2 <= H^2 <= H*K; consequently comparator coefficient is at most one.
Fixed-mass term H*K*m*log(1/(1-2^-s)) and action term (T-m)*2^-h are valid under stated rounding and conditional action-randomness contracts.
Full block public lookahead and actual computational prices are additional explicit interface requirements.
Random history-coupled comparators require min_i E L_i unless separately justified; independent exogenous random tapes admit a separate conditioning argument.
A purchased propensity must enter gamma; uniform core factor is recovered only for uniform probabilities.
Ticket denominator D=(B+1)*H*K requires new integer and intermediate-capacity accounting.
